Newsroom

Sanity is the editorial publishing system for DragonsRitual. The Studio runs separately during development so the public Astro application and editorial environment remain cleanly separated.

FROM THE PROJECT TERMINALnpm run newsroom

Then open http://localhost:3333. Sign in with the Sanity account that owns the DragonsRitual organization.
